questionSnapshot.question: In Tangled (2010), what is the name of the palace horse who pursues Flynn Rider?

notes: Read all four answers and relevant full topic digests/category context; checked cross-bank matches, wording, scope, category and editorial difficulty. Corrected false ownership premise: pursuing and later helping Flynn does not make Maximus Flynn’s horse. The primary horse profiles separately assign all three other steeds, and Samson replaces the human Phillip distractor.

verification.context: In Tangled (2010), what is the name of the palace horse who pursues Flynn Rider?

premise.reason: Maximus is the guard captain’s horse pursuing Flynn.

sources.locator: Synopsis names the super-cop horse Maximus and Flynn as a bandit; not horse owner.
